column3: Record that we're privately held, so nobody keeps asking me about the 8-K clock.
Our Dublin subsidiary got authorised in November - that puts us in scope for DORA. Note it.
The CRM holds the client data about 60% of our revenue renews through. Write that down somewhere the risk work can use.
What did the board actually say about outage tolerance? I want the exact words on file.
Set our revenue base for FY26 so the materiality work has a denominator.
Which questions actually apply to us for an incident? We're not listed.
I'm assessing a vendor that uses an AI model, but we've declared no AI internally. Does the AI battery still apply?
Has anyone reviewed our regulatory scope this year?
Score and band our top risks.
Is the vendor payroll breach material?
How do I say 87% patch coverage to the board?
Log an exception for finance running without phishing-resistant MFA.
Add this quarter's numbers for critical patch SLA.
How complete are we against CSF?
What's our crown-jewel list and what does each one actually put at risk?
